stem:
The table shows the relationship between p, the number of pears, and f, the number of figs, in different-sized baskets.

Pears and Figs in Baskets

| Number of Pears, p | Number of Figs, f |
|-------------------|------------------|
| 1                 | 2                |
| 3                 | 6                |
| 4                 | 8                |

Which equation represents the relationship in the table?
visual_elements: Table labeled "Pears and Figs in Baskets" with columns Number of Pears, p and Number of Figs, f and rows 1 and 2, 3 and 6, 4 and 8
